## Requirements to satisfy and stamp
- **GL-OBS-01** — metrics/logs/alerting for the live stack; wire the egress-budget alarm (INFRA.1)
  to a real notifier; keepalive verification; uptime + error budgets; log retention within the
  zero-cost posture; a dashboard/readout.

## Decision (ADR-077)
- **Notifier seam = recorded-alert JSONL ledger (always on) + stderr log + env-configured webhook.**
  No paid service; the webhook endpoint + optional bearer token are env-only (`SIG_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`
  / `SIG_ALERT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`, HG-09). Every alert is *recorded* (append-only JSONL) before/while it
  is *notified* — the record is the deterministic artifact; external delivery is best-effort.
- **Metrics = bounded JSONL probe log** (per-service ok/latency rows); **logs = bounded JSONL with a
  retention policy** (age + byte caps — a file, not a paid log service; zero-cost, SIG-STORE-003).
- **Uptime + error budgets** = a pure function over the probe log within a rolling window
  (`ops/config.toml [observability]`: `uptime_target_pct`, `window_days`, `retention_days`,
  `probe_log_max_bytes`).
- **Secret hygiene:** all alert/log text is scrubbed of env-secret values (`*_TOKEN/_SECRET/_KEY/
  _PASSWORD`, `SIG_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`) before write — no secrets in logs, asserted by test.
